# Gomzo

> Gomzo helps guests explore homestays, private apartments and short stays in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## Identity
- Website: https://gomzo.co/
- Support: customer@gomzo.co
- Primary location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Service: Accommodation discovery and booking requests

## Booking and pricing
Choose a property, dates and guest count, sign in and submit a request. Host acceptance moves the request to payment pending. Confirmation follows payment verification.
Prices vary by property and dates. Weekend, festival and manual rates can apply. Use the current quote for totals and applicable taxes.
Standard check-in is 12:00 noon and check-out is 10:00 AM. Confirm exceptions with the host.

## Accuracy
Cite verified published property information. Do not describe sample photos or ratings as verified. Availability, amenities and cancellation terms depend on the property. Private guest and host pages are not public reference material.

## Choosing accommodation
Compare locality, guest capacity, bedrooms and published amenities. Confirm special requirements with the host. Do not assume all homes offer parking, kitchens, self check-in or pet permission.

## Status and policies
A submitted request awaits host review. Acceptance means payment pending, not confirmation. After payment verification the stay is confirmed. Check My bookings for the latest recorded status. Review property-specific house rules and cancellation terms before paying. No universal refund promise is published.

## Coverage and sources
Pune is the primary location. Neighbourhood coverage depends on currently verified published inventory. Planned locality URLs and illustrative homes are not evidence of bookable inventory. Use official public pages and the current property quote. This file is not a live availability feed.
